**按时间正序**（老的在前），与游标推进方向一致: **In chronological order** (oldest first), matching the direction the cursor advances
RFC3339；来源没给就是空: RFC3339; empty if the source doesn't provide it
上一批返回的 next_cursor，**原样存回数据表**。留空 = 第一次拉: The next_cursor returned by the previous batch — **store it back into the data table as-is**. Leave blank for the first pull (fetches only the most recent batch, not the entire history)
为真表示这批拉满了，应当立刻再拉一次: True means this batch was full and you should pull again immediately
从一个来源拉新条目（RSS/Atom 或站点接口），产出统一的 JSON 条目: Pulls new entries from a source (RSS/Atom or a site API), producing uniform JSON entries plus an incremental cursor
从一个来源拉新条目，产出统一形状的 JSON。换来源不用改下游节点。: Pulls new entries from a source, producing uniformly shaped JSON. Switching sources requires no change to downstream nodes.
取境外源时可能需要: May be needed when fetching overseas sources
只对雪球有效：转发内容通常不是原创观点: Only applies to Xueqiu: reposted content is usually not an original opinion
按来源填：RSS 填 feed 地址；雪球用户填 uid（主页地址 xueqiu: Fill in based on the source: RSS — the feed URL; Xueqiu user — the uid (the string in the profile URL xueqiu.com/u/<this>); Xueqiu hot posts/flash news — leave blank; CLS (Cailianshe) telegraph — category (leave blank for the full stream); Eastmoney — keyword (e.g. a stock's name or code); Jin10 — channel number (leave blank for all flash news)
插件默认自己去首页取匿名令牌；被风控挡住时，把浏览器里的整条 Cookie 粘进: By default the plugin fetches an anonymous token from the homepage itself; if blocked by risk control, paste the entire cookie from your browser here
来源给多少是多少；RSS 常常只有摘要: Whatever the source provides; RSS often only has a summary
来源给的唯一标识；没有时用链接的哈希: The unique identifier provided by the source; falls back to a hash of the link if none is given
没有新内容时原样返回传入的游标: Returns the input cursor unchanged when there's no new content
留空用常见的桌面 Chrome UA: Leave blank to use a common desktop Chrome user agent
纯文本，已去掉 HTML 标签: Plain text, with HTML tags stripped
试着取一次雪球的匿名令牌。本插件多数来源不需要凭证，所以这里主要验网络是否通: Tries to fetch an anonymous Xueqiu token once. Most sources in this plugin don't need a credential, so this mainly checks network connectivity
